name: UsedVehicleReconTracker
tagline: Get used cars frontline faster – recon pipeline, stage SLAs and cap approvals in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete used-vehicle reconditioning app for Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages: a drag-and-drop pipeline from acquisition to frontline with stage SLA timers, recon cost versus cap with manager approvals, sublet vendor tracking, days-to-frontline, holding-cost and projected-gross KPIs. Works instantly with demo data; connect any table in a few clicks.
features: 7-stage pipeline with drag and drop and keyboard moves
Stage SLA timers and overdue flags
Recon cap per unit, % of ACV or fixed, with approve / reject
Projected gross and holding cost per unit
Sublet vendor desk with late flags
Holds, rework reasons, bulk moves and undo
Phone layout with stage picker and bottom bar
Power Fx outputs and events, no JSON needed
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field)
